enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn onto left side. Continue sleeping. Turn onto back. Continue sleeping. Turn onto right side. Continue sleeping. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping. Wake up at 06:30.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and getting ready for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up on bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Open bathroom door. Turn on light. Lift toilet lid. Urinate. Flush toilet. Lower toilet lid. Turn on tap. Adjust water temperature. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands together. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe mouth with towel. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out bowl. Place bowl on counter. Open cabinet. Take out cereal box. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Open drawer. Take out spoon. Close drawer. Sit at table. Eat cereal. Drink milk. Stand up. Place bowl and spoon in sink. Turn on tap. Rinse bowl. Turn off tap. Open dishwasher. Place bowl in dishwasher. Close dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Close closet. Lay clothes on bed. Remove pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to mirror. Comb hair. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put phone in pocket. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Listen to music. Bus stops. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk to office building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a community program coordinator
enriched_activities.desc: Enter office. Greet colleague. Walk to desk. Sit down. Turn on computer. Open email. Read emails. Type reply. Open calendar. Check schedule. Attend meeting. Sit in chair. Take notes. Speak to group. Return to desk. Make phone call. Write report. Print document. File papers.

Leave office. Walk to cafeteria. Stand in line. Order food. Pay cashier. Take tray. Find table. Sit down. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Wipe mouth with napkin. Stand up. Throw away trash. Return tray. Walk back to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a community program coordinator
enriched_activities.desc: Enter office. Sit at desk. Open computer. Read documents. Type report. Attend phone conference. Speak on phone. Write notes. Stand up. Walk to printer. Pick up printouts. Return to desk. Staple papers. File documents. Meet with colleague. Discuss project. Return to desk. Check email.
Leave office. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Listen to music. Bus stops. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter house.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Turn off stove. Take out plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Place plate in sink. Turn on tap. Rinse plate. Turn off tap. Open dishwasher. Place plate in dishwasher. Close dishwasher.

Enter living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Put remote down. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put phone down. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out drink. Close refrigerator. Return to couch. Sit down. Drink. Watch TV.

Enter bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open computer. Type password. Open browser. Check social media. Scroll through feed. Open email. Read email. Type reply. Open document. Edit document. Save document. Close browser. Open game. Play game. Close game. Shut down computer. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up.

Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Continue reading. Put book down. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Watch TV. Change channel. Adjust volume. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Lift toilet lid. Urinate. Flush toilet. Lower toilet lid. Turn on tap. Adjust water temperature. Wet face. Apply cleanser. Rub face. Rinse face. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wash body. Shampoo hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around body. Walk to bedroom.

Enter bedroom. Turn off light. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Breathe regularly. Turn onto left side. Continue sleeping. Turn onto back. Continue sleeping. Turn onto right side. Continue sleeping. Adjust blanket. Continue sleeping.
